According to Sarah Anne Williams (Jinx's voice actress), her death quotes' rendition ("HRRRRRK... bleh") was inspired by 'Red vs. Blue' by Rooster Teeth.[1]
Star Guardian Jinx's voice-over is the first one to feature three different characters.
Link▶️  "You get a bullet! You get a bullet! Everyone gets a bullet!" references Oprah's iconic line during her famous car giveaway.
Link▶️  "What do ya think? Mercy, or mayhem?" is a reference to a common moral choice in video games with diverging storylines.
When dying, Jinx cries out, Link▶️  "The horror... (gasps) the horror... Ha, haa...!" This is a reference to the last words of Mr. Kurtz in Joseph Conrad's novel Heart of Darkness.
Link▶️   "To infinity and—uh, oops. Wrong catchphrase!", is a parody of Buzz Lightyear's iconic phrase from the Disney/Pixar Toy Story franchise ("To infinity, and beyond!").

Link▶️  "'Robot' means 'slave'; I am robot to no one!" the real etymology of the word. "Robot" comes from Czecho-Slovak and is derived from "robota", meaning "drudgery, servitude".

Sion's accent during the quote also briefly changes to Schwarzenegger's notable accent, referencing his original voiceover's homage to the actor.

He refers to the  Kingdom of Camavor as Camaroar intentionally. This is most likely an artistic choice due to Camavor largely being influenced by dragons.
